exposure: subjective birth experience (perception of control, social support during labor and delivery)
cohort: The study included 269 mothers of full-term, healthy infants who gave birth in the year prior to the study.
finding: Mode of delivery showed a direct effect on how mothers describe their babies, but not maternal self-esteem, which was not mediated by subjective birth experience.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed a direct effect on how mothers describe their babies.
